newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oil output normal at North Sea Statfjord field.
newsitem.headline: Oil output normal at North Sea Statfjord field.

text.p: State Norwegian oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Wednesday offshore crude loadings and production at the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks oilfields had returned to normal following a bout of bad weather.

Statoil had been forced to reduce oil output at Statfjord B and C platforms due to burgeoning storage capacity after hurricane-force winds and high swell prevented shuttle tankers from mooring at the offshore loading buoys.
Throughput at Statfjord A and the Gullfaks development was not interupted.
"Everything is back to normal, we're back to full production," a Statoil spokeswoman said.
